models.notes: PRE-WINDOW model missing from inventory (preview 2026-05-30, GA in API 2026-06-22). Text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video with preset voices, native 1080p (added July 2026), up to 15s clips with synchronized audio.

models.name: Grok Imagine Image 2.0
models.notes: Quality Mode on grok.com/imagine and iOS/Android; region-level (magic wand/segmentation) editing, background removal, up to 5 reference images; #2 on Arena text-to-image and image-edit behind GPT-Image-2. Launch post said API 'coming soon' but docs.x.ai model table lists grok-imagine-image-2.0 at $0.04/image.

models.name: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0
models.notes: Speech-to-speech model; 24 languages; 0.70s time-to-first-audio; grok-voice-latest alias routed to it on 2026-08-05.

models.name: Grok 4.6
models.notes: Successor to Grok 4.5 on the same ~1.5T 'V9' base with improved SFT/RL; text+image in, text out; reasoning effort low/medium/high/xhigh; 'fast' variant at 2x price. Grok 4.7 (2.1T) announced by Musk for early September, not released.

models.name: Muse Glimmer 30B
models.notes: First open-weight MSL model; dense causal transformer (52 layers, ~1.8B ViT-G/14 perception encoder) distilled from Muse Spark, tuned for local agent loops on a single 24GB consumer GPU (K-Quant 17GB/20GB variants + DFlash speculative drafter). Text+image in, text out. Benchmarks: SWE-Bench Verified 76.0, MCP Atlas 75.5, GPQA Diamond 83.5. Integrations for llama.cpp/MLX/ExecuTorch/vLLM/SGLang/Unsloth.

models.name: Muse Spark 1.2
models.notes: Coding-focused update to Muse Spark 1.1 (code generation, debugging, codebase understanding, long-horizon agentic runs of 1,000+ tool calls / up to 24h). Ships with Muse Code terminal agent (beta, macOS/Linux). Standard tier no-training; 'contributor' tier is heavily discounted in exchange for training on data. Context window inherited from 1.1 (not restated in the announcement). Zuckerberg said on 2026-08-13 that Muse Spark 1.2 weights will be open-sourced; nothing published yet.
